[[Granite]] is a rock mined from [[granite rocks]], requiring 45 [[Mining]]. Granite rocks can be found in the [[Bandit Camp Quarry]] south of [[Bandit Camp (Kharidian Desert)|Bandit Camp]], at the [[Necropolis mine]] in the [[Necropolis]], and at the [[Cape Conch mine]] on [[The Great Conch]] island. The first two areas are subject to [[desert heat]], so players mining there need [[waterskin]]s, the [[circlet of water]], or the [[Desert amulet 4]] to avoid taking damage.

A piece of granite (any size) is required in the quest [[King's Ransom]], and two 5kg pieces of granite are required in the quest [[Enakhra's Lament]]. In a [[player-owned house]], five pieces of granite (5kg) can be used to upgrade an outdoor [[menagerie]] to a volcanic habitat, or two pieces of granite (5kg) can be used to build a [[volcanic theme]] in a [[superior garden]]. A piece of granite (any size) can be used to recolour the mining pet, the [[Rock golem]].

Unlike [[sandstone]], larger pieces of granite cannot be [[chisel]]ed down into smaller pieces. Attempting to chisel a 5kg piece outside of Enakhra's Lament displays the message {{mes|You don't need to craft the granite into anything.}}, and attempting to chisel down a 1kg or 2kg piece displays the message {{mes|This block of granite is too small to craft into anything.}}
